# apple_subscription_offer_code (Resource)

Defines an offer code for a subscription: a free or discounted period for eligible customers. Customers redeem it with custom codes or one-time-use codes. Only `active` changes in place; other changes create a new offer code. App Store Connect can't delete an offer code, so destroying the resource deactivates it. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_offer_code" "spring" {
  subscription_id        = apple_subscription.monthly.id
  name                   = "Spring"
  customer_eligibilities = ["NEW", "EXPIRED"]
  offer_eligibility      = "STACK_WITH_INTRO_OFFERS"
  offer_mode             = "FREE_TRIAL"
  duration               = "ONE_MONTH"
  number_of_periods      = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_eligibilities` (Set of String) Customers who can redeem the code: `NEW`, `EXISTING`, `EXPIRED`.
- `duration` (String) Length of each offer period: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS`, `ONE_YEAR`.
- `name` (String) Reference name of the offer code.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) Number of offer periods.
- `offer_eligibility` (String) How the offer combines with an introductory offer: `STACK_WITH_INTRO_OFFERS`, `REPLACE_INTRO_OFFERS`.
- `offer_mode` (String) Kind of offer: `FREE_TRIAL`, `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` (a discounted price each period) or `PAY_UP_FRONT` (one discounted price for all periods).
- `subscription_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription, e.g. `apple_subscription.example.id`.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the offer code can be redeemed. Deactivating is permanent, so setting it back to `true` creates a new offer code. Defaults to `true`.
- `auto_renew_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the subscription renews after the offer. Defaults to `true`.
- `plan_type` (String) Plan the offer is for: `UPFRONT` for the whole period at once, `MONTHLY` for a yearly plan billed monthly. Defaults to `UPFRONT`.
- `prices` (Attributes Set) Prices of a paid offer, one per territory. A free trial has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer code.

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Required:

- `price_point_id` (String) Price point of the offer in the territory; see `data.apple_subscription_price_points`.
- `territory` (String) Territory, e.g. `USA`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_offer_code.spring
  identity = {
    id = "9876543210"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer code.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_offer_code.spring 9876543210
```
